deployments_detail.use: AI integrated into payment products, incl. "agentic commerce" (autonomous transaction agents); company/CEO-disclosed strategic direction

A digital bank in Southeast Asia runs on HPS PowerCARD to launch card issuing, security, fraud and virtual-card services, described by HPS as 'supported by 350+ APIs, AI-driven processes and mobile-first capabilities such as dynamic CVV and QR payments' — a live client deployment of PowerCARD incorporating AI-driven processes. [HPS PowerCARD]

HPS Next-Gen Issuer Processing Platform offered as SaaS deployed on AWS, including a 'proven fraud prevention engine' and an authentication control server for 3DS with risk-based authentication for adaptive, transaction-risk-based security. Listed and deployed on AWS Marketplace. [HPS (PowerCARD); AWS (hosting)]

AI/ML fraud detection integrated into the PowerCARD-Fraud solution via a strategic partnership with US data-science firm Enigma. Enigma's machine-learning models (which 'detect and predict fraudulent activities') are combined with HPS's existing rule-based engine to cover payment issuance, acquiring and authorisation across HPS's global client base. [Enigma (AI/ML models); HPS PowerCARD-Fraud]

Same HPS-Enigma AI fraud-detection collaboration, independently reported by IBS Intelligence: Enigma's AI models delivered as 'cutting-edge AI fraud detection models to businesses worldwide' across the 95+ countries where PowerCARD operates, using a hybrid AI-plus-rules approach. [Enigma; HPS PowerCARD]
